data.overview: Two cash-strapped department-store workers plan a Christmas Eve robbery at the grandest shop in a British city, each hoping one score will solve their troubles. Their meticulous plan starts to unravel when the partners discover they may be falling for each other.
data.tagline: A little larceny. A lot of holiday spirit.
data.title: Christmas After Hours
